title: SANTA transaction-tier actuals
description: A runner's output for one transaction vector: each entry name -> { valid, cost, error, reason? }. valid is non-null IFF error is null (the runner produced a verdict). valid:false is a normal value (clean rejection), distinct from error:errored. Reason is a diagnostic note, never graded.

reason.description: Rejecting/erroring impl's reason string. Diagnostic only — not graded.

note.description: Panic message/class. Present iff error == 'panicked'; forbidden otherwise.

allOf.$comment: error null => valid non-null (a verdict); any non-null error => valid null.
